headline: Sankheshwar Holding Company discloses substantial acquisition in Nahar Spinning Mills under SEBI SAST regulations
sum: Sankheshwar Holding Company Ltd has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI's Takeover Regulations, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Nahar Spinning Mills Limited. The disclosure requirement is triggered upon crossing specified thresholds under the SAST regime.
detail: Sankheshwar Holding Company Ltd submitted the Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 3 July 2026 in accordance with SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a shareholder crosses prescribed shareholding thresholds. The filing indicates a material change in control or influence over Nahar Spinning Mills. Specific acquisition value, share count, and consideration structure are contained in the full disclosure document filed with the exchange.
